name: hcapp_getRunActivity
description: What a run has to show, for the activity icons on a run card: whether a PackTrack track exists (HC.EventTrack, or any attendance row with TrackPointCount > 0), how many runners recorded one, how many photos the viewer may see, chat messages and down-down charges. Batched: the app sends the '|'-delimited ids of the cards on screen. Since E5.F7.S1 (2026-09-12) the cards read these counts from the synced HC.Event columns instead; this SP remains for callers that still batch-fetch. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 94, @param NULL); no permission gate. Runtime errors are logged to HC.ErrorLog and re-thrown.

parameters.name: eventIds
parameters.description: '|'-delimited HC.Event.id values; invalid entries are dropped, duplicates collapsed Defaults to NULL when omitted (2026-10-13).

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: On auth failure only (ValidateAppAuth): { success=0, errorCode, errorType }, paired with StandardErrorResult at index 1. Mutually exclusive with RunActivity.
Paired with ErrorEnvelope on auth failure. Not present on success.

rowsets.name: RunActivity
rowsets.description: One row per valid id, unordered.

columns.name: hasTrack
columns.description: 1 when HC.EventTrack has a row or any attendance row carries a track — at least one GPS point was ever stored for the run

columns.name: runnerCount
columns.description: Attendance rows (HC.HasherEventMap, not removed) with TrackPointCount > 0 — how many runners recorded a track. 0 for an old track whose runner had no attendance row when the backfill ran

columns.name: photoCount
columns.description: Photos not deleted, at Status >= 2 or uploaded by the viewer

sideEffects: INSERT HC.ErrorLog from the CATCH block (lines 83-85, after ROLLBACK)

codeSmells.detail: These parameters have no SQL default, so a call that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs (unlogged empty 500): @deviceId, @accessToken. On 2026-10-13 every parameter whose body already handled NULL (and every sync watermark) was given a default; these remain because they are the auth pair or the body never checks them for NULL.
The SP sets SET NOCOUNT ON only. Harmless for a read with no transaction, but inconsistent with the HC6 SP standard, which requires both.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
